## {.title-slide .dark-slide}

::: {.game-kicker}
ESHPM · HTA negotiation game
:::

<h1>Negotiate access to a new treatment</h1>

<h3>The HTA course team</h3>

## The challenge is to balance access, health and affordability

A new orphan drug for a rare chronic muscle disease has received EMA
approval. **Benelux is the first country** considering reimbursement.

::: {.big-number-row}
::: {.big-number}
**500**<br>
eligible patients
:::
::: {.big-number}
**0.6**<br>
QALY per patient/year
:::
::: {.big-number}
**EUR 150,000**<br>
list price
:::
::: {.big-number}
**EUR 45m**<br>
treatment budget
:::
:::

## Two parties need one workable agreement

::: {.role-layout}
::: {.role-block}
<h3>Healthcare Payer — HCP</h3>

Secure health gains for the population while protecting the healthcare
budget and public support.
:::
::: {.role-block .role-block-purple}
<h3>Health Technology Developer — HTD</h3>

Achieve sales and meet shareholder expectations while establishing access
in the first reimbursement market.
:::
:::

## You can negotiate up to three patient segments

For each segment, agree on:

1. the **number of patients** treated;
2. the **price per patient**.

The segments together may cover no more than **500 patients**. One player
submits the complete group agreement in the app.

## New information changes the negotiation

::: {.round-flow}
::: {.round-item}
**Round 1**<br>
Shared baseline
:::
::: {.round-arrow}
→
:::
::: {.round-item}
**Round 2**<br>
Confidential HTD news
:::
::: {.round-arrow}
→
:::
::: {.round-item}
**Round 3**<br>
Confidential HCP news
:::
:::

Each round creates a new one-year agreement. Your app reveals new
role-specific information automatically.

## Negotiation time is deliberately limited

::: {.time-callout}
**10 minutes** internal preparation<br>
**+ 10 minutes** negotiation
:::

Use the preparation time to set priorities, a walk-away position, and the
arguments you are willing to share.

## Both parties are scored after every round

::: {.role-layout}
::: {.role-block}
<h3>HCP score</h3>

- QALYs gained — **60%**
- Share of patients treated — **40%**
:::
::: {.role-block .role-block-purple}
<h3>HTD score</h3>

- Sales — **60%**
- Sales expectations — **40%**
:::
:::

No agreement means very low scores for both parties. The final party score
is the sum across all rounds.

## Keep role-specific information confidential

When the app labels information for your role, do not show or read it to the
other party. You may decide how to use that knowledge in the negotiation.

During each round, note:

- your strongest arguments;
- what changed the other party’s position;
- why you accepted—or rejected—the final terms.
